RigBuilderUtils.luau.description: Helps build player characters or other humanoid rigs for use in a variety of situations. Public entry points include `jointBetween`, `addAttachment`, `RigBuilderUtils.disableAnimateScript`, `RigBuilderUtils.findAnimateScript`, `RigBuilderUtils.createR6BaseRig`, `RigBuilderUtils.createR6MeshRig`, `RigBuilderUtils.createR6MeshBoyRig`, `RigBuilderUtils.createR6MeshGirlRig`.
